name: Rick
business: Owner of a plumbing and HVAC company: two vans, a partner on the tools, an office helper part-time; quotes, bookings and invoices; customers call and text
tools: Google Calendar or a half-used field-service app (Jobber, Housecall Pro)
spreadsheets and a notebook for prices
day: On site until mid-afternoon, phone buzzing with leads and spam; quotes and invoices at the kitchen table at night; every customer exception lives in his head; margins look fine until the job is over.
